title: Coinbase does not fear competition from Wall Street, says exchange executive
CFTC员工因质疑特朗普关联加密公司遭清退
content: Odaily星球日报讯 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）部分职业官员因对 Polymarket、Crypto.com 及 Gemini Titan 提出合规质疑而遭清退，上述公司均被指与特朗普家族存在商业关联。报道称，时任 CFTC 代理主席 Caroline Pham 及高级法律顾问 Brigitte Weyls 曾介入相关审查流程，帮助上述公司获得批准或规避进一步调查。两人随后分别加入 MoonPay 与 Gemini Titan。据悉，相关官员此前曾担忧 Crypto.com 未公平对待小额散户、Polymarket 反欺诈机制不足，以及 Gemini Titan 尚未完成开业所需审查。此外，报道指出，特朗普第二任期期间，CFTC 已撤销至少 5 起加密调查，目前仅公布 2 起涉及数字资产的执法案件，且均针对个人运营者；相比之下，拜登政府时期相关案件超过 80 起。（纽约时报）

Binance Australia to Require Sender and Beneficiary Info for Crypto Transfers From July 1

Binance announced that from July 1, 2026, Australian users must provide sender information for incoming crypto deposits and beneficiary information for outgoing withdrawals to comply with local regulatory requirements. The rule applies to all crypto deposits and withdrawals. Transactions may be delayed, rejected, or returned if the required information is not provided.
